name: connection-facts-control-phone
description: At a phone viewport an editable connection fact stacks its label over its full-width control, while a read-only fact keeps PropertyList's compact 96px label column. The New connection form renders Name, Endpoint URL and the credential through these inline control rows; without the .controlRow stacking rule the fixed label column and gap leave those fields beside their labels instead of below them.

mutation.declaration: widgets/propertylist/propertylist.module.css: the @media (max-width: 480px) .controlRow { flex-direction: column; align-items: stretch; gap: var(--space-1) } stacking rule (deleted), leaving an editable fact beside its 96px label column
mutation.note: Observed red run without the rule: the control stayed beside the label in the 96px column, so the input's left edge did not match the label's and it was narrower than the row. Restoring the rule passes with the label over a full-width input and the help under it; a read-only fact stays side by side.
